note: Action card slots (DR-1, DR-3). Effect amount = die total x mult + add. A slot takes up to max_dice dice and fires with at least min_dice. Placeholder numbers, tuned with the bot.

items.name: Strike
items.text: Deal damage equal to the die.

items.name: Guard
items.text: Low die (1-4): gain block equal to the die + 1.

items.name: Pair Bet
items.text: Two dice showing the same number: deal their total x 2.
